releaseNotes:
• Dedicated Device Storage Directory: Automatically creates and maintains 'Documents/PulseForge AI/' on user device storing user profile, workouts, nutrition, and telemetry JSON files.
• Real Screen Time & Nighttime App Usage: Real hardware usage telemetry extracting daily screen time, nighttime phone duration (10 PM - 6 AM), and top late-night apps to assess sleep latency.
• Objective Sleep Window & Circadian Rhythm: Accurately deduces bedtime, wake time, and sleep disruption feedback from device inactivity.
• Real 9-Stream Sensor Telemetry: Live step count, cadence, pace, distance, elevation, and active calories with strict '-' integrity.
• Complete Device Capability Hub: Real-time status pills for storage readiness, camera permissions, hardware motion sensors, and usage stats access.
